name: Santa's Secret
source:
A desperate girl with α missing father turns to Chrome Steele P.I., an android detective heavily influenced by the fictional greats.

Chrome is led down an icy path of checkered pasts, shabby street Santas, and one decidedly dead elf in the pursuit of justice and redemption.

Can he find his own voice and the man at large before it's all too late?

[From [url=https://smallloanstudio.itch.io/santas-secret]itch.io[/url]]
